jobDescription:
Job Description It's not just about your career or job title… It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you're in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us. Who are we? Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers' potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more! In this role, you will: Should have in-depth understanding of system engineering to evaluate different solutions and choose the best path forward, ensuring that the team builds scalable and reliable systems. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the TCOS and Dispatch product line, understand the relationship and interaction across components, and clearly explain and define system behavior to the customer and development teams. Lead and contribute to future concepts and design enhancements for the TCOS products using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product/program requirements. Translate customer needs/requirements, resolve specification issues, handle technical correspondence, provide periodic updates, ensure customer satisfaction, and negotiate/coordinate with cross-functional teams as appropriate. Triage incoming customer reported problems, quickly determine if the expected behavior is not met, and define severity and priority. Actively look to reduce the investigation load from the team by performing the initial investigations until the reported system behavior is understood. Demonstrate expert level skill in problem decomposition and ability to navigate through ambiguity Engage frequently (80%) with the development team; facilitate discussions, provide clarification, story acceptance and refinement, testing and validation; contributes to design activities and decisions Provide accurate and timely status of Content plan and current execution status to Customer and leadership. Demonstrate superior persuasion and influencing skills that ensure alignment between customer, product manager and engineering team Demonstrates excelling business acumen, knows latest industry trends and is looked at as an internal expert on the product as well as the associated competitive landscape Provide technical input to customer-facing documentation such as user manuals, installation instructions, Serve as the work content authority for TCOS Project scrum teams responsible for the team's backlog, prioritization of the backlog, and represent the customer's needs to the teams. Coordinate with the scrum team Release Engineers who own their team's backlog. Own the overall project backlog and continuously order and prioritize to ensure sprint planning readiness. Collaborate with the Program Managers to define the short-term roadmap for sprint backlogs and prepare capabilities/features for planning. Collaborate to decompose features into vertical slice user stories with SMART acceptance criteria and well-defined business needs. Frequently engage the team to provide clarification, story acceptance and refinement and communicate decisions to the development team. • Understand security and compliance requirements; establish seamless integration with Cyber Security and Compliance teams Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or in "STEM" Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) A minimum of 5-6 years of professional experience in System Engineer or equivalent Role Eligibility Requirements: (Country Specific) Must be willing to work out of an office located in Bangalore, IN Desired Characteristics: Hands-on experience in decomposing requirements into robust Agile based Features and User Stories, including strong acceptance criteria and requirement traceability. Able to translate unstructured or ambiguous work requests into actionable user stories. Ability to understand the technology stack and its impact on the final product. Capable of efficiently conducting customer and stakeholder interviews and elaborate on personas. Experience with Rally, Jira, or other defect/work tracking tools. Capable of generating Agile metrics reports (burn-up, burn-down, velocity, etc.) and interpreting the results for larger audiences. Superior knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle and strong collaboration history with Quality Engineering and Dev Ops teams. Strong problem-solving abilities and capable of articulating specific technical topics or assignments to others. Ability to break down complex problems and estimate level of effort. Business Acumen: Demonstrates the initiative to explore alternate technology and approaches to solving problems Skilled in breaking down problems, documenting problem statements and estimating efforts Has the ability to analyze impact of technology choices Demonstrates knowledge of technologies in the market to help make buy vs build recommendations, scope MVPs, and to drive market timing decisions Leadership: Excellent communicator with customer and engineering. Demonstrates clarity of thinking to work through limited information and vague problem definitions Influences through others; builds direct and "behind the scenes" support for ideas. Pre-emptively sees downstream consequences and effectively tailors influencing strategy to support a positive outcome. Uses experts or third parties to influence decisions. Uses facts and not emotions to support ideas. Able to verbalize what is behind decisions and downstream implications. Continuously reflecting on successes and failures to improve performance and decision-making. Understands when change is needed. Participates in technical strategy planning. Proactively identifies and removes project obstacles or barriers on behalf of the team. Able to navigate accountability in a matrixed organization. Personal Attributes: Able to work under minimal supervision Excellent communication skills and the ability to interface with senior leadership with confidence and clarity Able to work well with global teams, including time-zone flexibility Skilled in providing oversight and mentoring team members. Shows ability to effectively delegate work. Lead and contribute to future concepts and design enhancements for the Trip Optimizer™ product using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product / program requirements. Translate customer needs / requirements, resolve specification issues, handle technical correspondence, provide periodic updates, ensure customer satisfaction, and negotiate / coordinate with cross-functional teams as appropriate. Participate in the development of proposals for projects. Work with Wabtec's scientific community and railroad subject matter experts to develop freight automation solutions, evaluate them in field trials and produce the solutions to function in a railroad revenue environment. Lead and participate in technical and program reviews. Maintain broad awareness of technical trends to ensure technical quality excellence, timely completion of work, and reviews and responsiveness to customer/program needs. Desired experience with prior system design experience with on-board distributed systems architecture Knowledge of AAR and CENELEC standards for the rail industry. Role Summary / Purpose We are seeking an Engineer to join the Engine & Power Solutions Center of Excellence (COE) in Bangalore. This role is responsible for supporting the design, development, validation, and continuous improvement of diesel engine components and systems throughout the product development lifecycle. The successful candidate will contribute to a range of engineering initiatives, including New Product Introduction (NPI), New Technology Introduction (NTI), productivity, cost optimization, and reliability improvement projects. Working in a global, cross-functional environment, the engineer will collaborate closely with design, manufacturing, sourcing, quality, validation, and supplier teams to develop and implement robust engineering solutions that meet performance, quality, cost, and schedule objectives. This position requires a strong engineering foundation, effective problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate is a quick learner, self-motivated, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a team. Experience with CAD tools, engineering drawings, and product development processes is considered an advantage. Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates in accordance with company policy. Key

Support the design, development, and validation of diesel engine components and subsystems to meet performance, reliability, cost, and quality objectives. Develop and maintain component specifications, validation plans, engineering documentation, and design records. Present technical solutions, project status, and engineering deliverables during design and technical reviews, ensuring compliance with engineering standards, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines. Collaborate with manufacturing, sourcing, quality, validation, and supplier teams to develop robust, manufacturable, and cost-effective solutions. Support component, engine, and field validation activities, including test planning, data analysis, and resolution of technical issues. Support root cause investigations and implement corrective actions to improve product performance and reliability. Assist in managing project deliverables related to quality, cost, schedule, and technical execution. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through innovation, simplification, and adoption of best engineering practices. Communicate technical findings, project status, risks, and recommendations effectively within cross-functional teams. Qualifications/Requirements Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 4 years of experience in mechanical product design, development, validation, or related engineering roles. Experience supporting component or subsystem development projects in engines, rail, automotive, heavy equipment, or similar industries Good understanding of product development processes, engineering documentation, and design release procedures. Knowledge of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, DFMEA, and GD&T. Experience working with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, sourcing, quality, validation, and suppliers. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment. Willingness to support testing, validation, and field issue resolution activities. Ability and willingness to travel as required. Desired Characteristics: Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline is preferred. Understanding of component and system-level validation methodologies. jobDescription:
Job Description It's not just about your career or job title… It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you're in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us. Who are we? Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers' potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more! Position Summary The Engineering Technical Leader will lead the architecture, development, validation, and lifecycle management of control systems for Auxiliary AC-AC Converters, Auxiliary Inverters, Auxiliary Load Controllers (ALC), Battery Charging Systems, and Traction Motor Controllers (TMC) used in locomotive and transportation applications. This role requires strong expertise in Power Electronics, Electric Drives, and Model-Based Design using MATLAB/Simulink. The successful candidate will drive advanced control development, controller modernization initiatives, embedded software integration, and platform migration activities while providing technical leadership across global engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Lead development of control algorithms and software architectures for Auxiliary Converter, Auxiliary Inverter, ALC, Battery Charger, and Traction Motor Control systems. Develop and validate advanced control functions including voltage/current regulation, DC-link control, PWM generation, vector control, traction control, dynamic braking, protection, diagnostics, and fault management. Drive Model-Based Design activities using MATLAB/Simulink, including simulation, verification, validation, and auto-code generation. Provide technical leadership for embedded software development and integration, including C/C++ implementation and optimization. Lead controller obsolescence management and technology refresh initiatives for existing control platforms. Execute migration of legacy controller applications to next-generation AMD/Xilinx Zynq Ultra Scale+ (ZU3) platforms and QNX RTOS-based architectures. Lead system integration, SIL, PIL, HIL, laboratory, locomotive, and field validation activities. Investigate field issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive corrective actions to improve product reliability and performance. Define technical roadmaps, architecture strategies, and future control solutions for locomotive propulsion and auxiliary power systems. Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across cross-functional and global teams. Collaborate with Systems, Hardware, Software, Validation, Manufacturing, Service, and Product Management teams throughout the product lifecycle. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Control Systems, or related discipline. 10+ years of experience in electric drives, power electronics, converter controls, inverter controls, or traction control systems. Strong expertise in MATLAB/Simulink Model-Based Design. Experience developing control algorithms for power converters, inverters, electric drives, and motor control applications. Working knowledge of embedded software development and C/C++ programming. Strong understanding of: Power Electronics Electric Machines and Drives Auxiliary Power Systems Traction Motor Controls Digital Control Systems Protection and Diagnostic Functions Experience with SIL, PIL, HIL, and system-level validation methodologies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Control Systems, or Electric Drives. Experience with locomotive propulsion and auxiliary power systems. Experience with controller modernization and platform migration projects. Hands-on experience with QNX RTOS and AMD/Xilinx Zynq-based controller platforms. Familiarity with d SPACE, OPAL-RT, RTDS, PLECS, or similar simulation and HIL tools. Knowledge of transportation communication protocols such as Arcnet, Ethernet. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical programs and mentor engineering teams. Leadership Expectations Act as the technical authority for Auxiliary Converter, Auxiliary Inverter, ALC, and Traction Motor Control development. Drive technical excellence, innovation, and product quality across programs. Lead architecture reviews, technical decision-making, risk mitigation, and project execution. Build organizational capability through coaching, mentoring, and knowledge sharing. Role Summary/Purpose The Wabtec Data & Analytics (D&A) team is driving the company's next-generation data and analytics ecosystem with a strong focus on Data Democratization, Self-Service, and AI-led innovation. Design, build, and curate high-quality datasets to support analytics and reporting use cases, including development of curation tables. Strong Experience in SQL and PL/SQL Create and maintain data documentation, user guides, and standards in Share Point to promote adoption and consistent usage. Develop and publish logical and physical data models and ER diagrams to support self-service and semantic layers. Collaborate with architecture and emerging technology teams on proof-of-concept evaluations of new data, analytics, and AI platforms. Help assess whether self-service tools are being used correctly, and guide users toward the most effective tools for their use cases. Contribute to self-service design patterns, implementation standards, and roadmaps based on business usage patterns. Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance. Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data. Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms. Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends. Perform in-depth data analysis, data modeling, and data design activities to support business and analytics needs. Hands-on experience with AI platforms (Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock) for designing and developing intelligent agents and workflow automation Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution. Hands-on experience or internships in data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, or business intelligence. Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, business-oriented terms. Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics principles, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and semantic layer design. Basic exposure to advanced analytics concepts such as predictive analytics, data mining, or statistical analysis is a plus. Understanding data storage and processing technologies including relational databases, columnar databases, Hadoop or Hive-based platforms. Strong Experience in data modeling concepts and tools such as ERwin or ER Studio. Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with technologies such as Spark, Hive SQL, Python, R, Sqoop, and JDBC or ODBC connectivity. Understanding data visualization best practices and storytelling through dashboards and reports. Desired Characteristics Experience working on IT or data projects in collaborative, cross-functional teams. Exposure to information systems design, implementation, or operational support. Familiarity with application development or data platform development concepts. Experience or exposure to data technologies such as Hive, Postgres, My SQL, SQL Server, Hadoop, or No SQL platforms. Experience with metadata management, data cataloging, or data lineage tools is a plus. Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and cloud data strategies is a plus. Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and customer-focused approach. Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with clear and structured communication. Ability to anticipate challenges and proactively develop mitigation plans. Change-oriented, with a continuous improvement of mindset and openness to new ways of working. Help assess whether self-service tools are being used correctly, and guide users toward the most effective tools for their use cases. Contribute to self-service design patterns, implementation standards, and roadmaps based on business usage patterns. Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance. Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data. Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms. Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends.
